scope: Second conservative local backfill from official Air National Guard, FAA/AirNav, and stable installation history sources.

candidates.name: Albany Naval Air Station (historical)

operational_intervals.label: Turner Field / U.S. Army Air Forces

candidates.source_notes: GlobalSecurity says the Navy commissioned the site as Naval Air Station Albany on July 1, 1967; installation histories list the earlier Turner Field/Turner AFB phases from 1941 onward and closure in 1974.
candidates.rationale: Exact overlay name match; intervals preserve the Army Air Forces, Air Force, and Navy phases rather than treating the NAS label as continuous from 1941.

candidates.name: Kellogg Air National Guard Base
candidates.source_notes: Official 110th Wing history says Kellogg Field in Battle Creek became home station for the 172nd Fighter Squadron by order of Michigan Governor Kim Siegler in 1947.
candidates.rationale: Official unit page directly ties the Battle Creek/Kellogg military installation to the 1947 Air National Guard home-station date.

candidates.name: Edwards Air Force Auxiliary North Base
candidates.source_notes: AirNav/FAA airport record for 9L2 Edwards Air Force Auxiliary North Base lists activation date 10/1944.
candidates.rationale: Exact overlay name and coordinates match an FAA-listed private military airfield; activation date is suitable for temporal visibility.

candidates.name: Lawson Army Airfield
candidates.source_notes: Installation histories say the Army created a rudimentary landing field at Benning in 1919 and renamed the airfield Lawson in 1931; it has operated continually as Lawson Army Airfield after transfer back to the Army in 1954.
candidates.rationale: Exact overlay name match; start year captures the first military landing-field use while source_notes preserve the 1931 Lawson naming.
